messages.subject: some apps on glimmer stopped working?
parts:

an error message like

Error: could not open file '/tmp/RtmpiUh8le/file542d59baf4dc.png'

Some of my own apps also stopped working, e.g.
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/yihui/06-anova/, but a few of them are
still fine.

Not sure if it is only me or a systematic problem.

Regards,

messages.author: 5651c5052a645ad8
messages.subject: Re: some apps on glimmer stopped working?
parts:
Dear Joe,
I'm having similar error messages for my older shiny apps,
 
 
Error: could not open file '/tmp/Rtmpi....
 
But it goes away when I simply copy the ui.R and server.R files to a newer app directory with a different name.
 
Speculating that Shiny server is caching a tmp file location associated with a particular url/app, but not updating its cached location when that tmp file inevitably gets deleted after some days or weeks.
 
Is that speculation correct?
And can you let us know how you solved the problem?
Many thanks!
- Joseph
